sn25.2:1.8: To “enter” (_okkanta_) is to step down or “trample”, or in the context of rebirth to descend or “be conceived” in the womb. For the sense here, compare Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 4.4.5.11: the sacrificer is led to a still pool in flowing water, into which he “descends” seeking release from Varuṇa’s snare. Here the commentary glosses _paviṭṭha_ (“entered”), a reading supported by _praveśa_ at Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 4.4.5.11.
